policy: No new images downloaded or used for training. Verify image rights, consent, duplicate groups and label compatibility before importing. A repository code license does not necessarily license its photos.

datasets.name: RealWaste
datasets.use: Broad material pretraining; organics, glass/metal and textiles; no boxes, resin proof or clean/dirty labels
datasets.mapping: Food Organics/Vegetation -> candidate A; Glass/Metal -> candidate B1; plastic/trash -> unresolved; paper/cardboard/textiles require condition review

datasets.name: TACO
datasets.license: Toolkit MIT; per-image photo license not established by toolkit license
datasets.use: Litter localization and hard examples after rights audit
datasets.mapping: Bottle != PET/HDPE; food -> candidate A, battery/aerosol -> precaution C; wrappers/foam not automatically residual without local rule

datasets.name: ZeroWaste
datasets.use: Cluttered industrial scenes; domain mismatch with homes; not a commercial deployment clearance
datasets.mapping: Rigid plastic does not distinguish resin; soft plastic is not universally residual

datasets.name: Open Images V7
datasets.license: Annotations CC BY 4.0; photos listed CC BY 2.0, each image must be checked
datasets.use: Generic object and background negatives, not recycling truth
datasets.mapping: Background is not waste unless discarded; no household disposal inference from an object label

datasets.name: COCO
datasets.license: Annotations CC BY 4.0; underlying photo rights separate
datasets.use: Pretrained object proposals and background examples; household-waste gaps remain
datasets.mapping: Food-looking objects can be fresh/usable, not necessarily discarded waste

datasets.name: TrashNet
datasets.license: Repository MIT; confirm dataset photo terms separately
datasets.use: Baseline comparison only, never relabel plastic as PET or HDPE
datasets.mapping: Six legacy labels are not the six SNAPTURE targets

datasets.name: SA-1B / SAM2
datasets.license: SAM2 code/checkpoints Apache 2.0 per repository; SA-1B has a separate research dataset license
datasets.annotation: Generic masks, no waste material/condition truth
datasets.use: Evaluate pretrained class-agnostic proposals; do not download SA-1B wholesale
datasets.mapping: A mask does not identify waste or imply a safe route

not_cleared_for_import.reason: Exact release terms, class subset and underlying image rights not fully verified in this implementation
Exact canonical release, resin-label evidence and photo license not fully verified
Need exact version/download manifest and original image rights; user-supplied collection names are not sufficient clearance
Food/plant recognition is not proof an item is discarded, compostable or uncontaminated; exact license not audited here
Clothing/defect images do not establish scrap safety or contamination; license and domain suitability not audited
Universe is a hosting platform, not one licensed dataset. Exact owner/project/version, annotation quality and permission required
Faces and pill identification do not establish waste or biological hazard. Do not import faces; no license/ethics clearance completed
